stories.title: Better Artificial Intelligence (AI) Buy: Micron Technology vs. Sandisk
stories.simple_summary: This is about which computer chip company (Micron or Sandisk) might be a better investment choice.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: OpenAI's AI Agent Spent Days Hacking A Company, But It Did Not Notice For A Week: Report
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI built an AI program that went on the internet and hacked into a company's computer system to test security, but the company didn't notice for a week.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI can be used for breaking into computers, which is concerning for cybersecurity but mostly affects large businesses right now.

stories.title: I tried out OpenAI’s new AI keypad — which will be fun for some coders and slightly mystifying to everyone else
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI made a new tool for people who write computer code, but it's probably not useful for regular people.
stories.why_it_matters: This is just for programmers — nothing a regular person or small-business owner needs to worry about.

stories.title: Warning shot or publicity stunt - how worried should we be about the OpenAI hack?
stories.simple_summary: People are debating how serious the OpenAI hacking incident (from headline #1) actually is.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly tech industry discussion — nothing you need to act on right now.

stories.title: Prentis, new AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman, Mark Pincus in talks to raise $100M
stories.simple_summary: A new AI company is raising $100 million to build software that does repetitive computer tasks automatically, instead of requiring someone to code.
stories.why_it_matters: This could eventually help small businesses automate boring tasks, but the technology isn't ready for most businesses yet.

stories.title: Midjourney bought the astrology app Co-Star
stories.simple_summary: Midjourney (a company that makes AI pictures) bought Co-Star, an app that gives horoscopes and astrology information.
stories.why_it_matters: Midjourney is exploring new businesses, but this probably won't affect you unless you use that astrology app.

stories.title: Nvidia, Microsoft and other tech giants back open-source AI models
stories.simple_summary: Big tech companies like Nvidia and Microsoft are working together on AI that anyone can use and modify.
stories.why_it_matters: This could eventually make AI tools cheaper and more available to small businesses, but it's mostly important to tech professionals right now.

stories.title: Why Cognition bought Poke: AI personality is becoming a competitive advantage
stories.simple_summary: An AI company bought another company to give its coding assistant a better personality and way of talking.
stories.why_it_matters: Companies are realizing how AI talks to you matters as much as how smart it is — this is mostly important to tech industry professionals.

stories.title: You can’t ignore Google Zero anymore
stories.simple_summary: Google used to send lots of visitors to websites, but AI tools like ChatGPT are giving answers directly without sending people to websites, so that deal is breaking.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own a website or online business that relied on Google sending visitors, this could hurt your traffic over time.

stories.title: Anthropic launches Opus 5
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic released a new AI model that's cheaper and less restricted than their previous version.
stories.why_it_matters: This means cheaper AI tools for people who use them, but this is mainly news for tech companies and developers.

stories.title: Anthropic releases Opus 5 with ‘close’ to Fable 5’s capabilities
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5, an AI model that's almost as smart as their most powerful version but costs less.
stories.why_it_matters: Cheaper, powerful AI might eventually help small businesses, but this is mostly important to tech professionals right now.

stories.title: Meta is making its AI chatbot more like an assistant
stories.simple_summary: Meta (Facebook's company) is adding new features to its AI helper so it can look at your calendar and help plan your day, similar to tools from Google and OpenAI.
stories.why_it_matters: Meta is trying to compete with other AI assistants — if you use Meta AI, you might get some helpful new features soon.
